findings.evidence: `ofSection_zero` splits on `by_cases hu : LocallyIntegrableSection I G fun x ↦ (0 : W x)`.
findings.fix: Add `theorem LocallyIntegrableSection.zero : LocallyIntegrableSection I G fun x ↦ (0 : W x)` (via `.smul` with `a = 0` or directly) and use it in `ofSection_zero`.
findings.issue: `LocallyIntegrableSection` gets `.add` and `.smul` but no `.zero`, so `ofSection_zero` has to split into cases and later work building the space of locally integrable sections lacks a basic fact.

summary: The new public definitions `sectionInChartAt` and `LocallyIntegrableSection` have hidden bodies but no `_def` lemmas, so consumers cannot work with them without unfolding; the closure API also lacks a zero case.
